images.title: Zainab's painting from 03:20 p.m.
images.purpose: A time line from 03:20 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. with a hop of 1 hour, a hop of 40 minutes and a hop of 10 minutes.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a time line with its labelled ticks and curved hops above it, and the working written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption Zainab starts painting at 03:20 p.m. and paints for 1 hour 50 minutes in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (34 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. TIME LINE: one thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (5 px) at y 430 from x 200 to x 1190, drawn at 9 px for each minute. TICKS: exactly 4 tall tick marks (44 px) at x 200, 740, 1100, 1190, each with a round dot (24 px across): teal blue #0072B2 at x 200; grey #6B7280 at x 740; grey #6B7280 at x 1100; amber #E69F00 at x 1190. TIME LABELS under the ticks, in dark #1F2937 bold (34 px): 03:20 p.m. centred at x 200, about y 505; 04:20 p.m. centred at x 740, about y 505; 05:00 p.m. centred at x 1100, about y 505; 05:10 p.m. centred at x 1190, about y 565. There are no other ticks and no other labels on the line. HOPS: exactly 3 curved arrows above the line, each a smooth arc (the top of an ellipse) with its arrowhead at the right end, landing on the line: hop 1 is teal blue #0072B2 (6 px), from x 200 to x 740 (540 px wide, 110 px high), label 1 hour centred above it; hop 2 is amber #E69F00 (6 px), from x 740 to x 1100 (360 px wide, 70 px high), label 40 minutes centred above it; hop 3 is reddish purple #CC79A7 (6 px), from x 1100 to x 1190 (90 px wide, 50 px high), label 10 minutes centred above it. Where a time label sits on the lower row (about y 565), a thin grey #6B7280 leader line (2 px) joins it to its tick. BOTTOM: centred at x 728 and about y 700, one line of bold dark text, 03:20 p.m. + 1 hour 50 minutes = 05:10 p.m. (48 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Zainab starts painting at 03:20 p.m. and paints for 1 hour 50 minutes
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 4 labelled ticks or 3 hop arrows, or hop widths that are not in proportion to 60, 40 and 10 minutes (540, 360 and 90 px)
images.takeaway: Add the hour first, 03:20 p.m. to 04:20 p.m., then 40 minutes up to 05:00 p.m., then the 10 minutes left: 05:10 p.m.
images.description: A time line from 03:20 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. with a hop of 1 hour, a hop of 40 minutes and a hop of 10 minutes.
images.context: Concept image for Time After. It follows the idea of the hops in your maths book (the time after a time found by hopping the hours and then the minutes) and shows the concept's own example of Zainab painting.
images.teaching_notes: Hop the hour first, then up to the next whole hour, then the minutes left. The slip to watch: writing 04:20 p.m. plus 50 minutes as 04:70 p.m.

image_decisions.why: The time line with the three hops shows the strategy of adding the hours first and then hopping to the next whole hour.
